# RePebble store assets

These files are prepared for the RePebble app listing:

| File | Size | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `emery_01-favorites.png` | 200 × 228 | Favourite stop overview |
| `emery_02-departures.png` | 200 × 228 | Upcoming departures |
| `emery_03-traffic.png` | 200 × 228 | Traffic status |
| `gabbro_01-favorites.png` | 260 × 260 | Favourite stop overview |
| `gabbro_02-departures.png` | 260 × 260 | Upcoming departures |
| `gabbro_03-traffic.png` | 260 × 260 | Traffic status |
| `lapin-fute-banner-720x320.png` | 720 × 320 | Optional store banner |

The screenshots are unmodified emulator framebuffer captures made with the
project's fixture data. They demonstrate the app UI but are not evidence of a
production-data or physical-watch test.

The banner is derived from the existing Lapin Futé visual identity and contains
no screenshot or watch mock-up.
